current: Record a manual resolution; this does not change session data.

current.appliedNote: A reviewed correction was applied to this finding.
current.structuralEvidence: Observations from the last scan. Review current values before applying a correction.
current.openDrive: Open drive #{{id}} in a new tab
current.openCharging: Open charging session #{{id}} in a new tab
current.duplicateHelp: Compare both sessions. If this session is a duplicate, move it to quarantine below; the other session stays active and the quarantined row can be restored.
current.overlapHelp: Compare both sessions and their timestamps. If you have evidence for the earlier session's correct end, review a correction below. Do not guess which boundary is wrong.
current.boundaryHelp: The end precedes the start. Check the original session evidence, then enter the correct end below if it is known; the application cannot infer it safely.
current.reviewHelp: Review the session evidence, then choose a correction below. Nothing changes until you confirm the preview.
current.uncertainHelp: Review the session and evidence before deciding whether to dismiss, quarantine, or record a manual resolution.
current.title: Correct this finding
current.durationHelp: Check the start and end times, then recalculate the duration from that window.
current.measurementHelp: Enter a value from a trusted source, or mark the incorrect measurement unknown.
current.verifiedValueHelp: Enter a value from a trusted source.
current.socHelp: Battery readings can legitimately change this way. Correct a reading only when you have evidence; otherwise consider dismissing the finding.
current.clearHelp: The recorded value will be removed. Some existing summaries may interpret missing readings differently.
current.valueRequiresEvidence: Enter a verified value or leave this finding open. Some existing views display an unknown reading as an actual value.
current.valueTooLarge: This value is too large to convert safely.
current.boundaryInstructions: Enter a time only when you have evidence. For an overlap, select the earlier session and end it no later than the other session starts. Start times cannot be changed here.
current.boundaryTarget: Which session has the incorrect end?
current.invalidLocalTime: Enter a valid time that exists in this time zone.
current.timeAmbiguity: If the clock repeats an hour, the first occurrence is used. Check the exact UTC time in the preview.
current.confirmMessage: Only the values shown below will change. The session and case are updated together and recorded in the audit log.
current.verifyWindow: Confirm the start and end are correct: the duration is calculated from those timestamps, not independently verified.
current.boundaryPreserved: Other measurements and telemetry associations remain unchanged; check them against the corrected session window.
current.clearWarning: Marking a measurement unknown removes its recorded value; it does not recover the measurement.
current.costInvalidated: The previous estimate depended on the incorrect energy value. It will be removed; reprice the session to calculate a new estimate. Actual or manually recorded costs are preserved.
current.reviewExpired: The case or write access changed. Cancel and review the current finding again.
